entries.text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_01

entries.text: A world of silvery white as far as the eye can see!\nTruly a view worthy of a Glitterati![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_02

entries.text: Sure is! And the cold is no match for these\nclothes you prepared for me, dearest O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_01

entries.text: Of course! They’re made from the highest-quality\nmaterials by the highest-quality brand, after all![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_03

entries.text: I feel sorry for people who climb this mountain\nin anything less...[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_02

entries.text: Hm...? Can it be?! Has our dearest commoner\nreturned to us once more?![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_04

entries.text: You’re right! Your eyes do not deceive you—our\ndearest commoner has returned to us once more![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_03

entries.text: Look, dearest O’Nare! Look at how thin the\nmaterial on our dearest commoner’s clothes is![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_04

entries.text: Oh my! That’s awfully flimsy, isn’t it?![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_05

entries.text: Say, Billy—do you suppose commoners have an\neasier time dealing with the cold?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_06

entries.text:
I’m not sure... But I’ve heard that commoners say
we Glitterati “line our pockets with money.”\c
Perhaps that means the high quality of our
clothing is unusual to them?[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_05

entries.text: If all commoners dress like our dearest one here,\nthen they must simply be used to the cold![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_06

entries.text: Billy, you’re...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_07

entries.text: you’re a true erudite! For this, I shall grant you\nthe Gold O’Nare Award![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_08

entries.text: YESSSS![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_07

entries.text: It’s our duty as Glitterati to lend a hand to the\nstruggling common folk.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_09

entries.text: In that spirit, I grant you these fine items. Hang\nin there and tough out the cold![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_10

entries.text: Now, you listen carefully, dear commoner. You\nmay have heard the saying “Cold hands, warm\r\nheart”... Don’t be fooled! It’s a load of hogwash![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_11

entries.text: You must never, ever forget that![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_12

entries.text: That’s my dearest O’Nare! Your aphorisms are\nbecoming more off-the-cuff by the day![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_08

entries.text: Come now, Billy! It’s about time our reprieve\ncame to a close.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_13

entries.text: I want to finish it with a look down at the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]centermost point of Paldea[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_woman_14

entries.text: Pfwee! Even the most extraordinary places are\nonly worthy of being looked down upon by you!\r\nYou really are an exemplary Glitterati, O’Nare![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_09

entries.text: We probably can’t get into the Great Crater, but\nlet’s make a request to the League, just in case![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_008_man_10

entries.text: Mr. Billy and Lady O’Nare went to climb a\nmountain covered in snow as pure as our\r\ncompany’s ideals.
entries.label: s1_sub_008_secretary_01

entries.text: Whether our company truly has pure ideals is\nup for debate—but no one will argue the purity\r\nof Glaseado Mountain’s snow!
entries.label: s1_sub_008_secretary_02
